scripts.build: pnpm --filter @godhand/shared build && pnpm --filter @godhand/db build && pnpm --filter @godhand/mcp-godot build && pnpm --filter @godhand/web build && pnpm --filter @godhand/server build
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter @godhand/shared build && pnpm --filter @godhand/db build && pnpm --filter @godhand/mcp-godot build && pnpm --filter @godhand/server build
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm build:backend && concurrently -k -n web,desktop -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @godhand/web dev" "wait-on -t 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:3000 && pnpm --filter @godhand/desktop dev"
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @godhand/desktop build && pnpm --filter @godhand/desktop run pack
